en: After we have thus presented absolute ethical life in the moments of its totality and constructed its idea, and have also destroyed as essenceless thought-things the distinction between legality and morality that prevails in relation to it, together with the abstractions of the general freedom of a formal practical reason connected therewith, and have determined the differences of the science of natural law and of morality according to the absolute idea not by any mixing of the two principles but by the sublation of them and the constitution of absolute ethical identity, we have laid it down that their essence is not an abstraction but the livingness of the ethical, and that their difference concerns only the external and the negative, and that this difference is at the same time the completely inverted relation to the other, since according to the latter natural law is to be given the formal and negative, morality however the absolute and positive, as essence, but in such a way that even this absolute, according to truth, is no less something formal and negative, and what is here called formal and negative is altogether and absolutely nothing at all.
zh: 我们已经这样在总体性的诸环节中展示了绝对伦理，建构了它的观念，也把在它那里占支配地位的合法性与道德的区别、连同与此相关的形式实践理性的普遍自由的那些抽象，作为无本质的思想物加以消灭，并且不是通过两个原则的混合，而是通过扬弃它们、建构绝对的伦理同一性，按照绝对观念规定了自然法科学与道德科学的那些区别，于是我们就确定下来，它们的本质不是一种抽象，而是伦理的东西的生动性，它们的区别只涉及外在的和否定的东西，而这种区别同时是与另一个区别完全颠倒的关系，因为按照后者，自然法应当被给予形式的东西和否定的东西作为本质，道德则应当被给予绝对的东西和肯定的东西当成本质，但这样一来，甚至这个绝对者按照真理也同样不乏形式性和否定性，而这里被称作形式的和否定的东西，干脆就是绝对的无。

en: In order now to indicate the relation of natural law to the positive sciences of law, we need only take up its threads there where we no longer pursued it, and to mark the place where it runs out.
zh: 我们如今为了还要指出自然法与实证法学的关系，只需在当初不再继续追踪它的地方把它的线索重新拾起，并标出它终止的那个位置。

en: Beforehand we remark in general that philosophy, through the universality of the concept of a determinacy or a potency, arbitrarily sets its own limit in relation to a determinate science.

The determinate science is nothing other than the ongoing presentation and analysis (the word taken in a higher sense) of how that which philosophy leaves undeveloped as a simple determinacy branches out again and is itself totality.

But the possibility of such a development lies formally in the fact that in the idea there is immediately the law of absolute form and of totality, according to which a determinacy is further to be cognized and developed.

But the real possibility is present in that such a determinacy or potency, not developed by philosophy, is not an abstraction or a truly simple atom, but, like everything in philosophy, reality, and a reality is reality because it is totality and itself the system of potencies; to present the potency as such is the development that belongs to the determinate science.
zh: 我们事先一般地指出，哲学通过一个规定性或一个级次的概念的普遍性，在与一门特定科学的关系中任意地给自己划定了界限。
特定的科学不是别的，只是持续的展示和分析（这个词取更高的意义），即哲学未加展开地作为单纯规定性留下的东西如何又重新分岔，并且自身就是总体性。
但这种发展的可能性在形式上就在于，在观念中直接地就有绝对形式和总体性的法则，按照这个法则，一个规定性还要被进一步认识并展开。
而实在的可能性之所以存在，是因为这样一种不由哲学展开的规定性或级次并不是一种抽象或真正单纯的原子，而是像哲学中的一切那样是实在性，并且一个实在性之所以是实在性，是因为它是总体性，甚至本身就是诸级次的系统；把级次作为这样的东西展示出来，就是属于特定科学的那种展开。

en: It follows from this that for the present we could say that a good part of what is called positive jurisprudence, perhaps the whole of it, would fall within fully developed and expanded philosophy, and that therefore, because they constitute themselves as sciences of their own, they are neither excluded from philosophy nor opposed to it; through the being-for-self and the empirical distinction of this corps of sciences no true distinction of it from philosophy is posited.

That they call themselves empirical sciences — which in part have their applicability in the actual world and want to make their laws and procedure valid also before the common manner of representation, in part relate to individual systems of existing constitutions and legislations and belong to a determinate people as well as a determinate time — determines no distinction necessarily excluding them from philosophy, for nothing must be so applicable to actuality and so much justified before the general manner of representation, namely the truly general one (for there are common manners of representation which are thereby very particular), as that which comes from philosophy, just as also nothing can [must] be so very individual, living and existing as precisely the same.
In order to be able to speak of the relation of these sciences to philosophy, a distinction must first be posited and determined whereby they are positive sciences.
zh: 由此得出，我们暂时可以说，被称为实证法学的东西中有很大一部分，也许它的全部，都会落入完全展开和铺展开来的哲学之中，并且它们之所以既不被排除在哲学之外，也不与哲学相对立，是因为它们把自己建构为自己的科学；通过这批科学的自为存在和经验的区分，并没有设定它与哲学的任何真正区分。

它们自称经验的科学——这些科学一部分在现实世界中有着自己的可应用性，并且要让自己的法律和做法在普通的表象方式面前也站得住脚，另一部分则涉及现存宪法和立法的个别体系，属于一个特定的民族以及一个特定的时代——这并没有确定出任何必然把它们排除在哲学之外的区分，因为没有什么东西必须像出自哲学的东西那样可应用于现实性、那样能在普遍的表象方式即真正普遍的表象方式面前得到辩护（因为有一些普通的表象方式在这方面十分特殊），同样也没有什么能够[必须]像这同一个东西那样如此个别、如此有生命、如此现存。
为了能够谈论这些科学与哲学的关系，首先必须设定并确定一个区分，凭这个区分它们才是实证的科学。

en: In the first place, then, the positive sciences, under the actuality to which they claim to relate, understand not only the historical, but also the concepts, fundamental propositions, relations and generally much that in itself belongs to reason and is supposed to express an inner truth and necessity.
To appeal, regarding such things, to actuality and experience and to hold them fast as something positive against philosophy must in and for itself be recognized as inadmissible.

What philosophy proves to be not real, of that it is impossible that it truly occur in experience; and if the positive science appeals to actuality and experience, then philosophy can likewise, according to the empirical relation, express its proof of the non-reality of a concept asserted by the positive science and deny that that which the positive science claims to find in experience and actuality is found in them.

That such a thing is experienced, a contingent subjective view, philosophy will of course admit; but the positive science, when it claims to find and point out its representations and basic concepts in experience, wants thereby to assert something real, necessary and objective, not a subjective view.
Whether something is a subjective view or an objective representation, an opinion or truth, philosophy alone can determine.

To the positive science it can give back its own way ad hominem, and, besides denying to it the fact that a representation of it occurs in experience, assert on the contrary that only the representation of philosophy is to be found in experience.
That philosophy can point out its representation in experience — the ground of this lies immediately in the ambiguous nature of what is called experience.
For it is not the immediate intuition itself, but the same raised into the intellectual, thought and explained, taken out of its singularity and pronounced as necessity, that counts as experience.
Thus, with what is pointed out in experience and as experience, what matters is not that in it which, in relation to the separation that is brought into intuition by thinking, we can call actuality.
But once intuition is drawn into the field of thought, opinion must yield to the truth of philosophy.

Now that distinction of what the positive science thinks it has taken immediately from intuition — whereby, however, it has itself determined it as a relation and concept of intuition — from that which does not belong to thought, is in every case very easy to point out, and thus to prove the complete authority of philosophy to take possession of it.

Then, because such a thinking that appeals to actuality tends, in its opinion, to be truly positive precisely by being in opposition and holding fast to determinacies, thus taking thought-things or things of imagination for absolute and taking its fundamental propositions from them, it is exposed to having, at every determinacy, the opposite determinacy proved against it, and to having, from what it assumes, precisely the contrary derived instead.

Just as, when increased density or specific weight of a body is explained as an increase of attractive force, it can just as well be explained as an increase of repulsive force, for attraction can take place only to the extent that repulsion does; the one has meaning only in relation to the other; by whatever amount the one would be greater than the other, by that much it would not be at all, and what therefore should be regarded as an increase of the one can be considered exactly as an increase of the contrary.
zh: 首先，实证科学在它们自称要与之相关的现实性之下，以概念把握到的不只是历史的东西，而且还有概念、根本命题、关系，以及一般说来许多自在属于理性、应当表达一种内在真理和必然性的东西。
对于这类东西援引现实性和经验，并把它作为某种实证的东西坚持来对抗哲学，这本身就必然被认作不可容许的。
哲学证明为并非实在的东西，它不可能真正出现在经验中；而如果实证科学援引现实性和经验，那么哲学同样可以按照经验的关系说出它对实证科学所主张的一个概念的非实在性的证明，并否认实证科学自称在经验和现实性中找到的那个东西会在它们中被找到。
认为这类东西会被经验到，这只是一种偶然的主观看法，哲学当然会承认；但实证科学如果自称在经验中找到并指出它的表象和基本概念，它借此要主张的就是某种实在的、必然的和客观的东西，而不是一种主观的看法。
某样东西是一种主观的看法还是一种客观的表象，是一种意见还是真理，这只有哲学才能判定。
对实证科学，哲学可以以其人之道（ad hominem）把它的做法回敬给它，并且除了否认它的一个表象出现在经验中这一事实之外，还可以反过来主张，在经验中能找到的只是哲学的表象。
哲学能够指出它在经验中的表象，这件事的根据直接就在于被称为经验的东西的那种含混本性之中。
因为算作经验的并不是直接的直观本身，而是把同一个直观提升到智性的东西之中、对它加以思维和解释、把它从它的单一性中取出并把它说成必然性。
所以，对于在经验中并作为经验被指出的东西，关键并不在于其中那个我们可以在与思维带入直观的那种分离的关系中称之为现实性的东西。
但直观一旦被拉进思想的领域，意见就必须让位于哲学的真理。
那么，把实证科学自以为直接从直观中取得的东西（而它借此却把这种东西规定为直观的一种关系和概念）与并不属于思维的东西区分开来，这种区分在任何情况下都很容易指出，并由此证明哲学完全有权占有这种东西。
其次，因为这样一种援引现实性的思维在它的意见中往往恰恰由于处在对立之中并固守各种规定性、从而把思想物或想象之物当作绝对者并从其中取出自己的根本命题，才真正是实证的，所以它就难免在每一个规定性上都被指出相反的规定性，并且从它所假定的东西中恰好引出相反的东西。
正如当一个物体的密度增加或比重增大被解释为吸引力的提高时，它同样也可以被解释为排斥力的提高，因为被吸引的只能和被排斥的一样多；一方只在与另一方的关系中才有意义；一方比另一方大出多少，它就恰恰有那么多根本不存在，而因此应当被看作一方之提高的东西，恰恰可以被看作对立面的提高。

en: Thus also, when in natural law generally, or in the theory of punishment in particular, a relation is determined as coercion, but philosophy proves the nullity of this concept and the positive science appeals to experience and actuality that after all coercion really is something real, that coercion really occurs, then the non-reality of it proved by philosophy can with just the same right and with appeal to experience and actuality be expressed thus, that there is no coercion at all and that no human being is ever coerced nor ever has been coerced.
For here everything depends solely on the explanation of the appearance, on whether, for the purpose of the representation of coercion, something is regarded as merely external or else as internal.

Where, then, the existence of coercion is to be demonstrated anywhere, there the very opposite can be shown of one and the same appearance, namely that it is not a coercion but rather an expression of freedom; for by being taken up into the form of representation and thereby determined through the inner, ideal element, the subject is in freedom with respect to it.

And if what is to be regarded as external and as coercion, in order to remove the opposition of the inner or of freedom, is relocated into the inner itself and a psychological coercion is accordingly asserted, then this taking up of the external into the inner helps just as little.
For thought remains absolutely free, and the psychological or thought-coercion is not able to bind it.

The possibility of sublating the determinacy that is represented and is to serve as coercion is absolute; it is absolutely possible that the loss of a determinacy which is threatened through punishment is taken upon oneself and that what the law wants to tear away in punishment is surrendered.

If, then, in the explanation of an appearance the representation of a determinacy is to act or to have acted as coercion, then the explanation from the contrary, that the appearance is an expression of freedom, is just as absolutely possible.

That the sensuous incentive — whether it is to drive to the action or, from the side of the law, to deter from it — is something psychological, namely something inner: thereby it is immediately posited into freedom, which could abstract from it or not, and the one as much as the other is freedom of the will.

But if it is objected that people do after all mean, and it is a general manner of representation, that a coercion, and a psychological one, occurs, then this is in the first place not true, but it is just as much and without doubt more generally meant that an action or the omission of an action comes from the free will; and then one would have just as little to trouble oneself about opinion in setting up fundamental propositions and determining laws as the astronomers, in cognizing the laws of the heavens, let themselves be detained by the opinion that the sun and the planets and all the stars move around the earth, are exactly as large as they appear, etc.; just as little as the shipmaster troubles himself about the opinion that the ship rests and the shores move on.

If both held to the opinion, then the former would find it impossible to comprehend the solar system, and the latter would let the rowers stop work or furl the sails, and both would at once find themselves in the impossibility of attaining their aim and would immediately become aware of the non-reality of the opinion at the very moment they wanted to concede its reality — as was shown above, that coercion thought as reality, i.e. represented in a system and in totality, immediately sublates itself and the whole.
zh: 同样，如果在自然法中一般地、或者在刑罚理论中特别地，一种关系被规定为强制，而哲学却证明这个概念的虚无，实证科学则举出经验和现实性说强制在现实中确实是一件实在的事情、强制也现实地发生，那么哲学所证明的强制的非实在性，也完全可以以同样的权利并援引经验和现实性这样来表达，即根本没有任何强制，也从来没有人被强制过或曾经被强制过。
因为这里完全只取决于对现象的解释，取决于为了强制的表象，某物是被看作单纯外在的东西，还是被看作内在的东西。
所以，凡是要在某个地方指出强制的存在，对同一个现象恰恰可以指出相反的东西，即它不是一种强制，而毋宁是自由的一种表现；因为一旦现象被纳入表象的形式、并由此通过内在的、观念的东西得到规定，主体就对它处于自由之中。
而如果为了消除内在的东西或自由的对立，把应当被看作外在的东西和强制的东西搬进内在的东西本身，并据此主张一种心理学的强制，那么这种把外在的东西纳入内在的做法同样无济于事。
因为思想始终是绝对自由的，而心理学的强制或思想强制并不能把它束缚住。
扬弃那个被表象、并应当充当强制的规定性，这种可能性是绝对的；完全可能的是，人们把刑罚所威胁的规定性的丧失承担下来，并把法律在刑罚中想夺走的东西交出去。
所以，如果在解释一个现象时，一个规定性的表象应当作为强制起作用或曾经起过作用，那么从对立面出发的解释，即这个现象是自由的一种表现，同样是完全可能的。
感性动机——不论它是应当推动行动，还是应当从法律那一方阻止行动——是某种心理学的东西，即某种内在的东西，它由此直接被置入自由之中，而自由既可以撇开它，也可以不撇开它，两者同样都是意志的自由。

但如果有人反驳说，人们毕竟是这样想的，而且这是一种普遍的表象方式，即存在着一种强制，而且是心理学的强制，那么这首先不是真的，因为同样地、而且毫无疑问更普遍地被想到的是，一个行动或不行动出自自由的意志；而这样一来，人们在提出根本命题和规定法律时就同样不必去操心这种意见，正如天文学家在认识天体的法则时不会让自己被那种认为太阳、行星和所有星辰都围绕地球运动、都恰好和它们看起来一样大等等的意见所耽搁；也正如船主不去操心船停着而岸在移动这种意见。
如果两者都固守这种意见，那么前者就会发现根本无法以概念把握太阳系，后者就会让桨手停工或收帆，而两者立刻就会陷入无法达到自己目的的境地，并且在他们想要承认这种意见的实在性的同时，直接察觉到这种意见的非实在性，——正如上面已经指出的，强制被当作实在性来思维，也就是说，在一个系统中、在总体性中被表象，就立刻扬弃自己以及整体。

en: Since thus a determinacy that is held fast by the opinion of positive science is the direct opposite of itself, it is equally possible for both parties, each of which holds to one of the opposed determinacies, to refute the other, and this possibility of refutation consists in showing of each determinacy that it is not at all thinkable and is nothing at all without relation to the one opposed to it; but by the fact that it only is and only has meaning in relation to this one, this opposed determinacy can and must immediately be present and exhibited in just the same way.

That + A has no sense without relation to a - A, from this it is to be proved that with + A there is immediately - A, which the opponent then grasps in such a way that rather - A is present here than + A; but to his - A precisely this can be retorted.

Often, however, this trouble is not taken either, and e.g. in the case of the freedom opposed to the sensible incentives, which for the sake of this opposition is just as little a true freedom, it is not shown that everything that would be explained as an expression of this freedom must properly be explained as an effect of the sensible incentives, which can very well be done, but no more than conversely it can again be shown that what is to be experienced as an effect of the sensible incentive must properly be experienced as an effect of freedom; instead, abstraction is made from freedom outright and it is asserted that it does not belong here at all, because it is something inner, still more something moral, and even something metaphysical, but it is not considered thereby that the other determinacy at which one stops, namely coercion and the sensible incentive, through which coercion is supposed to be posited as something external, has no meaning at all without the opposed inner thing or freedom, and that this freedom is absolutely inseparable from coercion.

The action that is a crime, considered from the side that through it, contrary to the threatened punishment and the sensible incentive that the law sets up through this threat, something determinate is willed, this determinate thing is called something sensible, and one will say that it is a sensible stimulus from which the crime stems; but from the side that the action is a willing, and the possibility in it of abstracting from the sensible incentive of the law, it appears as free, and no view, neither that determinacy nor this possibility, can be omitted, but the one is absolutely linked to the other, and thereby each can immediately be derived from its opposite.

But the logic of opinion opines that, if a determinacy, an opposed item, is posited, one can really abstract from the other, opposed determinacy and dispense with it, just as that logic too, by virtue of the kind of its fundamental proposition of contradiction, cannot at all conceive that in such determinacies the opposite of each is wholly indifferent for the determination of intuition and that in this abstracting and negative essence the opposite is completely equal to its opposite, still less that both together, like the freedom that is opposed to sensibility, and sensibility and coercion, are absolutely nothing real, but mere thought-things and essences of imagination.
zh: 所以，既然一个被实证科学的意谓坚持住的规定性恰恰是它自己的反面，那么对双方来说——每一方都坚持那些彼此对立的规定性中的一个——，反驳另一方就同样可能，而这种反驳的可能性就在于：对每一个规定性都指出，它若没有与它相对立的那一个的关系，就根本不可思维、根本什么都不是；但正因为它只是在与这个对立面的关系中才存在、才具有意义，这个对立的规定性也就同样能够并且必须直接存在、直接显示出来。
从“+ A 若没有对某个 - A 的关系就没有意义”出发，要证明的是：有了 + A 就直接有 - A；对手则把这一点把握成这样：这里现成存在的毋宁是 - A，而不是 + A；但针对他的 - A，恰恰可以同样回敬这一点。

但人们往往也不肯费这番功夫，例如对于与感性动机相对立的自由——这种自由由于这种对立，同样不是一种真的自由——，就不去表明：凡是想被解释为这种自由的表现的东西，本来都必须被解释为感性动机的作用；这固然很可以做得到，但也不比反过来能表明的更多：凡是想被当作感性动机的作用来经验的东西，本来都必须被当作自由的作用来经验；——人们反而干脆从自由抽象掉，断言它根本不属于这里，因为它是某种内在的东西，更是某种道德的东西，甚至某种形而上的东西，但在这里没有想到：另一个规定性，也就是人们所停留于其上的那个规定性，即强制和感性动机——据说强制是通过感性动机才被设定为某种外在的东西的——，若没有那个与之对立的内在的东西即自由，就根本没有任何意义，而且自由是绝对无法与强制分离开来的。

这行为既然是一种罪行，从这一面来看，即它违背了所威胁的刑罚和那种法律通过这一威胁设立起来的感性动机，于是有某种确定的东西被意愿，那么这个确定的东西就叫某种感性的东西，人们会说，罪行是从一种感性刺激来的；但从另一面来看，即这行为是一种意愿，并且在它之中有从法律的感性动机抽象掉的可能性，它就显得是自由的；而无论那一个规定性还是这一可能性，哪一种看法都不能省略，毋宁说，一个是绝对与另一个联结在一起的，因此每一个都可以直接由它的反面推导出来。

但意谓的逻辑以为，如果一个规定性、一个对立的东西被设定起来，那么人们就可以真的从另一个对立的规定性抽象掉、可以不要它，正如那种逻辑凭它那条矛盾的根本命题的方式，也根本不能以概念把握：在这样的规定性里，每一个的反面对直观的规定来说都完全无所谓，并且在这种抽象掉和否定的本质里，反面与它的反面完全等同；它更无法以概念把握的是：这两者合在一起，就像与感性相对的自由，以及感性和强制那样，绝对不是什么实在物，而只是单纯的思想物和想象的本质。

en: Insofar, then, as a jurisprudence is positive by holding to opinion and to essenceless abstractions, its appeal to experience, or to its own determination of applicability to actuality, or to sound common sense and the general manner of representation, or even its appeal to philosophy, makes not the slightest sense.
zh: 所以，一种法学既然是靠固守意见和无本质的抽象才成为实证的，那么它援引经验，或者援引它自己对现实性的可应用性的规定，或者援引健全常识和普通的表象方式，甚至援引哲学，就都没有丝毫意义。

en: If we now consider more closely the ground through which science becomes positive in the indicated way, and generally weigh the ground of illusion and of opinion, it turns out that this ground lies in the form, namely in that what is ideal, being something opposed and one-sided and having reality only in absolute identity with the opposed, is isolated, posited as being for itself, and pronounced to be something real.

It is this form through which intuition is immediately sublated [is], and the whole, dissolved, ceases to be a whole and something real; this distinction of the positive and the not positive therefore does not concern the content.

Through this form it is possible that not only, as in what was indicated above, a purely formal abstraction is fixed and falsely asserted to be a truth and reality, but also that a true idea and a genuine principle is misjudged as regards its limit and is posited outside the potency in which it has its truth, and thereby completely loses its truth.

That a principle belongs to a potency is the side of its determinacy; but in the potency itself this determinacy is present as equally rendered indifferent and really permeated by the idea, and is thereby a true principle; and then, appearing as the idea in these determinacies as its shape, it is cognized only as the principle of this potency, and thereby its limit and conditionedness is cognized.
But it is torn entirely out of its truth if it is made absolute in its conditionedness or even spread out over the nature of other potencies.

The absolute clear unity of ethical life is absolute and living in this, that neither a single potency nor the subsistence of the potencies generally can be firm, but that it, just as it eternally expands them, equally absolutely strikes them together and sublates them, and enjoys itself in undeveloped unity and clarity, and in relation to the potencies, sure and indivisible in its inner life, now does damage to one through another, now passes over entirely into one and annihilates the others, just as it, out of this movement, likewise withdraws into the absolute rest in which all are sublated.

By contrast, illness and the beginning of death are present when a part organizes itself and withdraws from the dominion of the whole, through which isolation it negatively affects the whole or even compels it to organize itself solely for this potency, as when the liveliness of the entrails that obeys the whole forms itself into its own animals, or the liver makes itself the ruling organ and compels the whole organization to serve its activity.

Thus it can happen in the general system of ethical life that, for example, the principle and system of civil law, which is directed to possession and property, deepens itself so into itself and, in the broad expanse in which it loses itself, takes itself for a totality that is in itself unconditional and absolute.

The inner negativity of this potency has already been determined above also as regards its content, which is the existing finite; and the reflection of indifference that is possible in it can all the less be taken for something absolute, just as equally little can the system of acquisition and possession itself, the wealth of a people, and within this system again a single potency, be it agriculture or the manufactories and factories or trade, be made into the unconditional.
zh: 如果我们现在更仔细地考察那个使科学以所指出的方式成为实证的根据，并且一般地思量假象和意见的根据，结果就是：这个根据在于形式，——也就是说，那种观念的东西，既然是一个对立的东西、片面的东西，并且只有在与对立面的绝对同一性中才有实在性，就被孤立起来、被设定为自为存在着的，并被说成是某种实在的东西。
正是这种形式，使直观直接被扬弃[了]，使被分解的整体不再是一个整体、不再是某种实在的东西；所以这种实证的东西与非实证的东西的区别并不涉及内容。
通过这种形式，就不仅可能像在上面所指出的那样，把一个纯粹形式的抽象固定下来、并错误地把它主张为一种真理和实在性，而且也可能：一个真正的观念和真正的原则从它的界限方面被误认，并被设定到它拥有自己的真理的那个级次之外，从而完全失去它的真理。
一个原则属于一个级次，这是它的规定性那一面；但在级次本身之中，这种规定性同样是无差别化了的、并且实在为观念所贯透地在此存在，因此是真正的原则；而这样一来，当它作为观念、在这些规定性中作为观念的形态而显现时，它就被认识为只是这个级次的原则，而它的界限和条件性也就由此被认识了。
但如果它在自己的条件性中被弄成绝对的，甚至被扩展到其他级次的本性之上，那它就被完全从自己的真理中扯了出来。

伦理的这种绝对清晰的统一之所以是绝对的和活生生的，就在于：既不能有一个单个的级次，也根本不能有诸级次本身的持存，而是它把诸级次——正如它永恒地扩展它们那样——同样绝对地击碎并扬弃，并且在未展开的统一和清晰中享受自己，而在与诸级次的关系中，它对自己内在的生命确信不移、不可分割，时而通过一个级次损害另一个级次，时而完全过渡到某一个级次之中并消灭其他级次；同样，它一般地从这种运动中又退回那种绝对的安宁，在那种安宁中一切都被扬弃了。
相反，如果某个部分自己组织起来并脱离整体的统治，那就出现了疾病和死亡的开端，——通过这种孤立化，它给整体一种否定性的触动，甚至迫使整体只为这一个级次而组织自己——，就像内脏那种服从整体的生动性把自己形成为自己特有的动物，或者肝脏使自己成为起统治作用的器官，并迫使整个组织为它的活动服务。
所以在伦理的普遍系统中也可能发生这样的事：例如市民法的原则和系统——它针对的是占有和财产——如此深陷于自身之中，并且在它迷失于其中的那种广阔铺展里，自认为是一个自在的、无条件的、绝对的总体性。
上面已经规定了这个级次就其内容而言的内在否定性，而它的内容就是现存的有限东西；至于在它之中可能的那种无差别的反照，就更不能被当作某种绝对的东西，——同样，获取和占有本身的系统、一个民族的财富，以及在这个系统里又一个单个的级次，不论是农业，还是手工工场和工厂，还是商业，也都同样不能被弄成无条件的。

en: But a single potency becomes positive still more when it and its principle forget their conditionedness so thoroughly that they reach over into others and subject them.

As the principle of mechanics has intruded into chemistry and natural science, and that of chemistry again quite especially into the latter, so has this been the case in the philosophy of the ethical at different times with different principles.

But in modern times, in the inner household of natural law, this external justice, the infinity reflected in the existing finite and therefore formal, which constitutes the principle of civil law, has acquired for itself a particular supremacy over state law and the law of nations.

The form of such a subordinate relation as the contract has intruded into the absolute majesty of ethical totality, and e.g. for the monarchy the absolute universality of the centre and the being-one of the particular in it has been conceived now, according to the contract of authorization, as a relation of a supreme state official to the abstraction of the state, now, according to the relation of the common contract in general, as a matter of two determinate parties, each of which needs the other, as a relation of mutual performance, and through such relations, which lie wholly in the finite, the idea and absolute majesty have immediately been annihilated; just as it is also contradictory in itself if for the law of nations, according to the relation of the civil contract, which is directed immediately to the singularity and dependence of the subjects, the relation of absolutely independent and free peoples, which are ethical totalities, is to be determined.

Thus state law as such could also relate itself absolutely to the individual and, as a perfect police, want to penetrate wholly the being of the individual and so annihilate civil freedom, which would be the harshest despotism; as Fichte wants all doing and being of the individual as such to be overseen, known and determined by the universal and the abstraction opposed to it.

The moral principle could also intrude into the system of absolute ethical life and want to place itself at the head of public as well as private law and also of the law of nations, which would be as much the greatest weakness as the deepest despotism and the complete loss of the idea of an ethical organization, since the moral principle, like that of civil law, exists only in the finite and the individual.
zh: 但一个单个的级次还会更加成为实证的，如果它和它的原则如此严重地忘记了自己的条件性，以至于越界侵入其他级次并使它们服从自己。
正如力学的原则已经挤进了化学和自然科学，而化学的原则又尤其挤进了后者，在伦理的东西的哲学里，不同的时代也曾经有不同的原则发生过这种情况。
但在新的时代里，在自然法的内部家政中，这种外在的公正——即在现存的有限东西中被反思到的、因而形式上的无限性，它构成市民法的原则——已经为自己取得了对国家法和国际法的一种特殊支配地位。

像契约这样一种从属关系的形态，已经挤进了伦理总体性的绝对威严之中，而且例如对君主制来说，中心的绝对普遍性以及特殊的东西在中心的合而为一，时而按照授权契约被理解为最高国家官员对国家的抽象物的一种关系，时而按照普通契约的关系被理解为两个特定党派的事情——其中每一方都需要另一方——，被理解为一种相互给付的关系，并且通过这样一些完全处在有限东西之中的关系，观念和绝对威严就直接被消灭了；同样，如果对国际法来说，要按照市民契约的关系——这种契约直接针对诸主体的个别性和依赖性——来规定绝对独立而自由的诸民族的关系，而这些民族是伦理的总体性，那么这本身就是矛盾的。
同样，国家法本身也可能径直针对单个的东西，并且作为一种完备的警察，想完全穿透单个者的存在，从而消灭市民自由，而这会是最严酷的专制；正如费希特想要让单个者作为这样的单个者的一切所做和存在，都由与它相对立的普遍东西和抽象来监视、知道和规定。
道德的原则也可能挤进绝对伦理的系统，并且想把自己摆到公法、私法以及国际法的首位，——而这既会是最大的软弱，也会是最深的专制，还会是伦理组织的观念的完全丧失，因为道德的原则就像市民法的原则一样，只存在于有限的东西和单个的东西之中。

en: Just as in science such a becoming-firm and isolating of the individual principles and their systems and their reaching over into others is prevented solely by philosophy — since the part does not recognize its limit but must rather have the tendency to constitute itself as a whole and absolute, while philosophy, in the idea of the whole, stands above the parts and thereby both holds each within its limit and, through the sovereignty of the idea itself, prevents the part from proliferating in its dividing into endless smallness — so in reality this restricting and idealizing of the potencies presents itself as the history of ethical totality, in which it, in time, firm in its absolute equilibrium, oscillates up and down between the opposed terms, now admonishes state law of its determinacy through a slight preponderance of the civil element, now through the preponderance of the latter makes incursions and rents in the former, and so generally reanimates each system in part through a more powerful indwelling for a time, in part reminds all in their separation of their temporality and dependence — as it also destroys their proliferating expansion and their self-organization by confounding them all at once in individual moments, presenting them drawn into itself and letting them go out again reborn from the unity, with the memory of this dependence and with the feeling of their weakness if they want to be for themselves.
zh: 正如在科学中，诸个别原则及其系统的这种固定化和孤立化、以及它们对其他原则的越界侵入，只有靠哲学才被阻止——因为部分不认识自己的界限，反而必然有把自己建构为一个整体和绝对者的倾向，而哲学却在整体的观念中立于诸部分之上，既由此把每一个都保持在它的界限之内，又通过观念本身的至上地位防止部分在其不断分割中向无穷的细小东西里蔓延滋长；同样，在实在性中，对诸级次的这种限制和观念化设定，表现为伦理总体性的历史，在历史中，伦理总体性在时间里稳固地处于自己的绝对均衡之中，在诸对立面之间上下摇摆，时而通过市民的东西的一点轻微优势提醒国家法注意自己的规定性，时而又通过前者的优势闯入国家法并造成裂痕，从而一般地使每一个系统一部分由于一种更有力的内住而在一段时间里重新获得生命，一部分则使所有系统在它们的分离中想起自己的时间性和依赖性；——同时它也这样摧毁了它们那种蔓延的扩展和自我组织：它在个别环节中一下子把它们全部混淆起来，把它们收进自身来展示，并让它们从统一中重新生出来，带着对这种依赖性的记忆，带着对自己软弱的感受——如果它们想自为地存在的话——，重新走出去。

en: This character of the positivity of the sciences of law concerns the form through which a potency isolates itself and posits itself as absolute; and from this side, just like religion, and whatever it may be, every philosophical science too can be inverted and defiled.
But we must also consider positivity from the side of matter.

For although both what we called positive a moment ago and what we now consider as matter are something particular, we nevertheless considered a moment ago the external connection of the form of universality with particularity and determinacy, whereas now we consider the particular as such.
zh: 法学的这种实证性的品格涉及形式，即一个级次借以把自己孤立起来并设定为绝对的那种形式；而从这个方面来看，就像宗教以及无论什么东西一样，每一门哲学科学也可能被颠倒、被败坏。
但我们也必须从质料方面来考察这种实证性。
因为尽管我们刚才称为实证的那个东西，以及我们现在当作质料来看待的那个东西，两者都是特殊的东西，但我们刚才考察的是普遍性的形式与特殊性和规定性的外在结合，而现在我们考察的则是特殊的东西本身。

en: And in this respect we must above all take the side of what, according to its matter, can be posited as positive, against formalism; for formalism tears apart intuition and its identity of the universal and the particular, sets the abstractions of the universal and the particular over against one another, and whatever it can exclude from that emptiness but subsume under the abstraction of particularity counts for it as positive — without considering that through this opposition the universal becomes just as much something positive as the particular, for, as was shown a moment ago, it becomes positive through the form of opposition in which it is present in that abstraction.

But the real is absolutely an identity of the universal and the particular, and therefore that abstraction, and the positing of one of the opposed terms which arise through the abstraction, namely of the universal as something existing in itself, cannot take place.

On the whole, if formal thinking is consistent, then when it conceives the particular as positive it must absolutely have no content at all; in the pure reason of formal thinking every plurality and distinguishability must fall away entirely, and it is quite impossible to see how it should even arrive at the most meagre plurality of rubrics and chapters; just as those who conceive the essence of the organism as the abstraction of a life-force must properly conceive and leave out the limbs and the brain and the heart and all the entrails as something particular, contingent and positive.
zh: 而在这个方面，我们首先必须为那种按其质料可以被设定为实证的东西而反对形式主义；因为形式主义撕碎了直观以及直观中普遍的东西和特殊的东西的同一性，把普遍者的抽象和特殊者的抽象相互对立起来，而凡是它能从那种空洞中排除出去、又能归摄到特殊性的抽象之下的东西，在它看来就都算作实证的东西，——却没有想到：通过这种对立，普遍的东西也和特殊的东西一样成为实证的东西，因为正如刚才已经指出的，它通过它在那种抽象中于其中存在的那种对立的形式，成了实证的。
但实在的东西干脆就是普遍的东西和特殊的东西的一种同一性，因此那种抽象，以及把由抽象产生的诸对立面中的一方、即普遍的东西设定为自在存在的东西，就不可能成立。
一般说来，如果形式思维是前后一贯的，那么当它把特殊的东西作为实证的东西以概念把握时，它就干脆根本不能有任何内容；在形式思维的纯粹理性里，任何多数性和可区分性都必然消失，而且根本看不出它怎么会达到纲目和章节的那种最贫乏的多数；同样，那些把有机体的本质以概念把握为一种生命力的抽象的人，其实也必须把肢体、大脑、心脏和一切内脏都以概念把握为某种特殊的、偶然的、实证的东西，并把它们略去。

en: By the fact that, as everything living, so also the ethical is absolutely an identity of the universal and the particular, it is an individuality and a shape; it bears particularity, necessity, relation, i.e. relative identity, within itself, but indifferentiated, assimilated, and thereby it is free in it, and this, which can be regarded by reflection as particularity, is not something positive nor something opposed to the living individual, which thereby hangs together with contingency and necessity, yet livingly; this side is its inorganic nature, but in the shape and individuality has organized itself onto it.

Thus, to name the most universal, the determinate climate of a people and its period belong to the formation of the universal genus of necessity, and of its widely extended chain only one link falls upon its present, a link which on the former side is to be grasped in concepts from geography, on the other from history.

But into this link ethical individuality has organized itself, and the determinacy of this link concerns not that same individuality, but necessity; for the ethical livingness of the people consists precisely in this, that it has a shape in which the determinacy is, but not as something positive (according to our previous use of this word), but absolutely united with universality and enlivened by it.

And this side is also very important for this reason, that it be cognized how philosophy teaches to honor necessity — both because it is a whole and only limited insight clings to singularity and despises it as a contingency, and also because it so sublates the view of singularity and contingency that it shows of it how it does not in itself hinder life, but that this, while it lets it subsist as it is according to necessity, at the same time also tears it away from that necessity, penetrates and enlivens it.

Just as the element of water, onto which one part of the animal world, and the element of air, onto which another part organizes itself, are not — for the reason that they are individual elements — something positive or dead, the former for the fish, the latter for the bird, so too this form of ethical life, in which it organizes itself in this climate and in this period of a particular and of the universal culture, is not something positive in it.

As in the nature of the polyp there is the totality of life just as much as in the nature of the nightingale and of the lion, so the world spirit has in every shape enjoyed its duller or more developed, but absolute, self-feeling, and in every people, under every whole of customs and laws, its essence and itself.
zh: 由于伦理的东西正如一切活生生的东西一样，干脆就是普遍与特殊的同一性，所以它是一个个体性，也是一个形态；它在自身中带有特殊性、必然性、关系，即相对的同一性，但已经被无差别化、被同化，因此它在其中是自由的，而这个可以被反思看作特殊性的东西，并不是某种实证的东西，也不是与活生生的个体相对立的东西——后者因此与偶然性和必然性相关联，但却是活生生地相关联；这一面是它的无机的自然，但已经在形态和个体性中把自己组织到它上面。
所以，举最普遍的东西来说，一个民族的特定气候及其时期，属于必然性这个普遍类属的形成，而从必然性这条宽广铺开的链条上，落到它当下的只有一个环节，这个环节从前者那一面要凭地理学、从另一面要凭历史来以概念把握。
但是，伦理的个体性已经把自己组织进了这一环节，而这一环节的规定性所涉及的不是这种个体性本身，而是必然性；因为民族的伦理的活生生状态恰恰在于：它有一个形态，规定性就在这个形态里，但不是作为某种实证的东西（按照我们至今对这个词的用法），而是绝对地与普遍性结合在一起，并且被普遍性赋予生命。
而这一面之所以也十分重要，也是为了让人们认识到，哲学如何教导人去尊重必然性：既因为它是一个整体，而只有有限的见识才死抓住个别性不放，并把它当作偶然性来轻视；也因为它这样扬弃了关于个别性和偶然性的看法，以致它指出这种看法并不自在地阻碍生命，而是生命在让它按照必然性继续存在的同时，又把它从必然性那里夺过来，贯穿它并赋予它生命。
正如水这一元素——动物世界的一部分把自己组织到它上面——和空气这一元素——另一部分把自己组织到它上面——并不因为它们是个别的元素，就对鱼、对鸟成为某种实证的或死的东西，同样，伦理的这一形式，即伦理在这种气候中、在这个时期里把自己组织到一种特殊的文化和普遍的文化中的形式，在伦理中也不是某种实证的东西。
正如在水螅的自然中，生命之总体性与在夜莺和狮子的自然中一样多，世界精神也在每一个形态中享有它那更迟钝的或更展开的、但却是绝对的自我感受，并且在每一个民族中、在每一套习俗和法律的整体之下，享有它的本质和它自身。

en: Outwardly the stage is equally justified — which external side belongs to necessity as such; for also in this abstraction of necessity singularity is again absolutely sublated through the idea; this singularity of the stage of the polyp, of the nightingale and of the lion is a potency of a whole, and in this connection it is honored.

Over the individual stages hovers the idea of totality, which, however, reflects itself back out of its whole scattered image and intuits and cognizes itself therein; and this totality of the extended image is the justification of the individual as something subsisting.

It is therefore the formal standpoint that brings the form of particularity to an individuality and sublates the livingness in which particularity is real — but the empirical standpoint, which, where the reality of a determinate stage is posited, demands a higher one.

The higher one, also in its developed reality, and empirically, is likewise present; the higher development of the life of the plant is in the polyp, the higher one of the polyp in the insect, etc.; it is only empirical unreason that wants to behold in the polyp the empirical presentation of the higher stage of the insect; the polyp that would not be a polyp remains nothing but this determinate dead piece of matter, standing with me in an empirical relation, which is dead and matter through this, that I posit it as an empty possibility of being something else, which emptiness is death.

If it is absolutely not a matter of an empirical relation to the higher presentation, then it is to be found, for according to absolute necessity it must be present. — Thus, e.g., the feudal constitution can indeed appear as something wholly positive; but in the first place, from the side of necessity, it is not an absolute singular, but absolutely within the totality of necessity; inwardly, however, in relation to life itself, whether it is positive depends on whether the people in it has truly organized itself as individuality, completely fills out and livingly penetrates the shape of that system, whether the law of these relations is custom.

If, then, the genius of a nation stands generally lower and is a weaker one — and the weakness of ethical life is hardest in barbarism and in formal culture — if it must let itself be conquered by another and lose its independence, thus has preferred the misfortune and disgrace of the loss of self-subsistence to struggle and death, if it has sunk so crudely into the reality of animal life that it does not even raise itself into formal ideality, into the abstraction of a universal, and thus in the determination of relations for physical need can bear not the relation of right but only of personality, — or likewise, if the reality of the universal and of right has lost all faith and all truth and it is unable to feel and enjoy the image of divinity in itself, but must posit the same outside itself and put up with it with a dull feeling or the wholly painful one of wide distance and sublimity, then feudal constitution and bondage have absolute truth, and this relation is the only possible form of ethical life and therefore the necessary and just and ethical one.
zh: 对外而言，这一阶段也同样得到辩护——这一外在的方面属于必然性本身；因为在必然性的这种抽象中，个别性又通过观念而被干脆扬弃了；水螅、夜莺和狮子这一阶段的这种个别性是一个整体的级次，而在这个联系中它是受到尊重的。
在诸个别阶段之上悬浮着总体性的观念，但这一观念从它整个散开的图像中反照回来，并在其中直观自己、认识自己；而这幅展开的图像的总体性，就是个别的东西作为持续存在者的辩护。
因此，是形式的立场把特殊性的形式带给一个个体性，并扬弃特殊性在其中成为实在的那种活生生状态——而经验的立场则在一个特定阶段的实在性被设定的地方要求一个更高的阶段。
更高者，即使在其展开的实在性中，并且经验地看，也同样存在；植物的生命的更高发展就在水螅身上，水螅的更高发展就在昆虫身上，等等；要在水螅身上看到昆虫的更高阶段的经验性表现，那只是经验的无理性；那个不成其为水螅的水螅，剩下的无非是这块特定的、与我处于一种经验关系中的死物质，它之所以是死的、是物质，就在于我把它设定为一种空洞的可能性，即成为某种别的东西的可能性，而这种空洞性就是死。
如果它绝对无关乎与更高表现的经验关系，那么它就是找得到的，因为按照绝对必然性它必定存在。——所以，例如封建制度完全可以显得是某种完全实证的东西；但第一，从必然性方面说，它并不是一个绝对的个别东西，而是干脆处在必然性的总体性之中；而在内面、就生命本身来说，它是否是实证的，则取决于民族是否在其中真正把自己组织为个体性，是否完全填满并活生生地贯穿了那个系统的形态，取决于这些关系的法律是否是习俗。

所以，如果一个民族的天才一般地站得更低、是一种更弱的天才——而伦理的软弱在野蛮状态中和在形式的文化中最为严酷——，如果它不得不被另一个民族战胜、不得不丧失自己的独立，也就是把丧失自主性的不幸和耻辱看得比斗争和死亡更可取，如果它如此粗野地沉入动物性生命的实在性，以致它甚至没有把自己提升到形式的观念性、提升到一个普遍东西的抽象，因而在规定那些为肉体需要而设的关系时，不能忍受权利的关系、而只能忍受人格性的关系，——或者同样，如果普遍东西和权利的实在性已经丧失了一切信仰和一切真理，它不能在自己本身中感受和享有神性的图像，而不得不把这一图像设定在自己之外，并且以一种迟钝的感情、或者以那种遥远和崇高的极其痛苦的感情来将就它，那么封建制度和奴役就有绝对的真理，而这一关系就是伦理唯一可能的形式，因而是必然的、正当的和伦理的形式。

en: From this individuality of the whole and the determinate character of a people, then, the whole system into which absolute totality organizes itself is also to be cognized; it is to be cognized how all parts of the constitution and of legislation, all determinations of the ethical relations, are absolutely determined through the whole and form a building in which no connection and no ornament was present for itself a priori, but each has come to be through the whole and is subordinated to it.

In this sense Montesquieu founded his immortal work on the intuition of the individuality and the character of peoples, and, even if he did not raise himself to the most living idea, he yet absolutely did not deduce the individual institutions and laws from so-called reason, nor abstract them from experience and then raise them to something universal, but understood — as the higher relations of the parts of public law, so also the lower determinations of civil relations down to testaments, marriage laws, etc. — solely out of the character of the whole and its individuality, and thereby showed to the empirical theoreticians, who suppose they have cognized the contingencies of their systems of the state and of the laws out of reason and taken them from common sense itself or else from general experience, in a way intelligible to them, that the reason and the common sense and the experience from which the determinate laws come are no reason and common sense a priori, also no experience a priori, which would be an absolutely universal one, but solely the living individuality of a people — an individuality whose highest determinacies are again to be grasped in concepts out of a more universal necessity.
zh: 因此，从这个整体的个体性和一个民族的特定性格出发，也要认识绝对总体性把自己组织进去的那个整个系统；要认识到，宪法和立法的一切部分、伦理关系的一切规定，如何干脆由整体来规定，并构成一座建筑，在其中没有任何联系和任何装饰是自为地 a priori 就现成存在的，而是每一个都通过整体才产生出来，并且隶属于整体。

在这个意义上，孟德斯鸠把他的不朽著作建立在关于各民族的个体性和性格的直观之上，而且，即使他没有把自己提升到最有生命力的观念，他也干脆没有从所谓的理性中演绎出那些个别的制度和法律，也没有把它们从经验中抽象出来、然后提升为某种普遍的东西，而是像国家法权诸部分的较高关系那样，也把市民关系的较低规定、直到遗嘱、婚姻法等等，完全只从整体的性格及其个体性来以概念把握，并由此以一种他们能够理解的方式向那些经验的理论家表明——这些理论家自以为从理性中认识了他们的国家和法律体系的种种偶然，并且是从常识本身或者也从一般经验中取来的——，那些特定法律所出自的理性、常识和经验，并不是 a priori 的理性和常识，也不是 a priori 的经验（那会是一种绝对普遍的经验），而完全只是一个民族的活生生的个体性——这样一种个体性，它的最高规定性又要从一种更普遍的必然性来以概念把握。

en: As was shown above in relation to science, that every individual potency can be fixed and science can thereby become positive, just this must be asserted of the ethical individual or of the people.

For according to necessity, totality as the subsistence of the scattered determinacies must present itself on it, and the individual link of the chain under which it is posited in the present must pass away and another enter.

While the individual grows in this way, one potency emerging more strongly and the other receding, it happens that the parts which have organized themselves in the latter find themselves separated out and dead.

This division, in which some things reach out toward a new life, while the other, which has settled itself on the stage of a determinacy, remains behind and sees life fleeing from itself, is possible only through this, that the determinacy of a stage has been fixed and formally made absolute.

The form of the law, which has been given to the determinate custom and which is the universality or the negatively absolute of identity, gives it the semblance of something that is in itself; and if the mass of a people is great, then the part of it that organizes itself in that determinacy is also great, and the consciousness that is in the law over it has a great weight over the unconscious of the newly aspiring life.

When custom and law were one, the determinacy was nothing positive; but as with the growth of the individual the whole does not advance uniformly, so law and custom separate, the living unity that binds the members weakens, and in the present of the whole there is no longer any absolute connection and necessity.

Here, therefore, the individual cannot be cognized out of itself, for its determinacy is without the life which explains it and makes it intelligible; and since the new custom likewise begins to comprehend itself in laws, an inner contradiction of the laws among themselves must absolutely emerge.

As in the preceding history is only one side of the view and what is necessary is at the same time free, so on the contrary here necessity is no longer one with freedom and in this respect falls wholly to pure history; what has no true living ground in the present, its ground is in a past, i.e. a time is to be sought in which the determinacy fixed in law, but dead, was living custom and in agreement with the rest of the legislation.

But the effect of the purely historical explanation of laws and institutions does not reach further than precisely for this purpose of cognition; it will overstep its determination and truth if through it the law, which had truth only in a past life, is to be justified for the present.

On the contrary, this historical cognition of the law, which knows how to point out its ground solely in lost customs and a dead life, precisely proves that it now lacks sense and meaning in the living present, even if it still has power and force through the form of the law and through the fact that parts of the whole are still in its interest and tie their determinate being to it.
zh: 正如上面在涉及科学时已经指出的：每一个别级次都可能被固定下来，科学由此可能变成实证的，同样，这一点也必须就伦理的个体或者民族来断言。
因为按照必然性，总体性必须作为那些散开的规定性的持续存在而在它身上呈现出来，而链条上它于当下被置入其下的那个个别环节必须过去，另一个环节则进入。
当个体以这种方式成长，一个级次更强地凸显出来、另一个则退回去时，就会出现这样的情形：那些在后者中把自己组织起来的部分，发现自己已被分离出去、已经死去。
这种分裂——其中有一些东西向新的生命伸出手去，而另一些已经在一种规定性的阶段上安顿下来的东西则留在后面，眼看着生命从自己身边逃走——之所以可能，仅仅是因为一个阶段的规定性被固定下来，并且在形式上被弄成了绝对的。
法律的形式——它被赋予特定的习俗，并且是同一性的普遍性，或者说，是同一性中那个否定地绝对的东西——给了习俗一种自在存在者的假象；而如果一个民族的群众很大，那么其中在那规定性里把自己组织起来的部分也很大，法律中凌驾于它之上的那种意识，对新生生命的无意识就占有很大的分量。
当习俗和法律还是一体的时候，规定性并不是任何实证的东西；但正如随着个体的成长，整体并不以同样的步调前进，法律和习俗也就分离开来，把各个环节联结起来的那种活生生的统一体衰弱下去，而在整体的当下之中，再也不存在绝对的联系和必然性了。
所以在这里，个体不能从它自身得到认识，因为它的规定性缺少那解释它、使它可理解的生命；而当新的习俗同样开始在法律中把握自己时，法律彼此之间就必然会出现一种内在的矛盾。
正如在前面，历史只是观点的一面，而必然的东西同时又是自由的，与此相反，在这里必然性不再与自由是一体的，就此而言完全落归纯粹的历史；在当下没有真正活生生的根据的东西，其根据在过去，也就是说，必须去找一个时代，在那时，法律中被固定下来、但已经死去的规定性曾经是活生生的习俗，并且与其余的立法相一致。
但法律和制度的纯粹历史的解释，其作用并不超出恰好为这个认识目的所需的限度；如果借助它要把那只有在过去的生活中才有真理的法律为当下辩护，那它就超出了自己的规定和真理。
相反，这种关于法律的历史认识，只知道在丢失了的习俗和一段死去了的生命中指出法律的根据，它恰恰证明：法律现在在活生生的当下中缺少意义和含义，即使它凭借法律的形式、并凭借整体中还有部分处在它的利益之中、把自己的定在系于它，而仍然拥有权力和暴力。

en: But for the correct distinction of what is dead and has no truth and of what is still living, a difference is to be recalled which the formal view can miss and which must prevent that what is in itself negative be taken for living law and thus the dominion of the in-itself negative laws be taken for the being-alive of the organization.

For laws which withdraw individual determinacies and parts from the supremacy of the whole, exclude its power from them and constitute the exceptions of the individual from the universal, are in themselves something negative and a sign of beginning death, which becomes ever more threatening for life the more the negative and the exceptions become and these laws, which aim at this dissolution, become too powerful for the true ones, which constitute the unity of the whole.

To the positive and dead must therefore be counted not only that which belongs wholly to a past and has no living present any more and only an unintelligible and, because it is without inner meaning, shameless power, but also that is without truly positive truth which fixes the negative, the dissolution and separation from the ethical totality; the former is the history of a past life, the latter the determinate representation of the present death.

Thus in a dissolved people, as indeed in the German one, the laws can seem to have truth if one does not distinguish whether they are laws of the negative and of separation or laws of the truly positive and of unity.

Immediately with this, that the laws organizing a whole have significance only for a past and relate to a shape and individuality that has long since been cast off as a dead husk, that they have interest only for parts and thereby posit not a living relation to the whole but a power and dominion foreign to it, and that that in which a living bond and inner unity presents itself has, as means for its end, no longer the least appropriateness, so that this means has neither sense nor truth — for the truth of the means consists in its being adequate to the end, through which innermost untruth of the whole it then also follows that in the science of philosophy generally, in ethical life, likewise in religion, little that is true can any longer be — immediately with this, the dissolution determines and consolidates itself and posits itself in a system of the negative, thus gives itself the formal semblance both of cognition and of laws whose inner essence is the nothing.

If the cognition and science of such a people expresses itself as this, that reason cognizes and knows nothing and is only in empty freedom, as a flight, in the nothing and in its semblance, then the content and essence of the negative legislation is that there is no law, no unity, no whole; that first untruth is therefore the one which is it unconsciously and naively, but this second one, which assumes the form and thereby consolidates itself.
zh: 但是，为了正确区分什么是死的、没有真理的，什么是还活生生的，就要提醒注意一个差别，这个差别可能被形式的观点漏掉，而且它必须防止：自在否定的东西被当作活生生的法律，从而自在否定的那些法律的统治被当作组织的有生命状态。
因为那些把个别的规定性和部分从整体的最高统治中抽走、把整体的暴力从它们那里排除出去、并构成个别东西对普遍东西的例外的法律，自在地就是某种否定的东西，是开始死去的标志；这种死亡对生命变得越来越有威胁，因为否定的东西和例外越变越多，而这些走向这种解体的法律对那些构成整体统一的真正的法律变得过于强大。
因此，算作实证的和死去了的东西的，不仅是完全属于一个过去、不再有任何活生生的当下、并且只有一种不可理解的、而且因为它没有内在含义因而无耻的权力的东西，而且那把否定的东西、把从伦理的总体性中的解体和分离固定下来的东西，也同样没有真正实证的真理；前者是一段过去生命的历史，后者则是当下之死的特定表象。
所以在一个解体的民族中——例如在德意志民族中确实如此——，法律可能显得是有真理的，如果人们不区分它们是否定的东西和分离的法律，还是真正实证的东西和统一的法律。

一旦那些把一个整体组织起来的法律只对一段过去有意义，只与一个早已作为死去的躯壳被蜕掉的形态和个体性相关，一旦它们只还与部分的利益相关，并因此设定的不是对整体的活生生的关系，而是一种与整体相异的暴力和统治，一旦那种其中展现出活生生的纽带和内在统一的东西作为达到其目的的手段不再具有丝毫的适合性，因而这个手段既没有意义也没有真理——因为手段的真理就在于它适合于目的，由此也就产生了整体的最内在的非真理，即在哲学的科学中、在伦理中、同样在宗教中，真的东西再也不可能有多少——，那么，解体就直接由此得到规定和固定，把自己设定在一个否定的东西的体系之中，从而给自己一种既像认识、又像法律的形式假象，而这些法律的内在本质就是无。
如果一个这样的民族的认识和科学表达出：理性什么都不认识、什么都不知道，只处于空洞的自由中，作为一种逃避，处于无中以及无的假象中，那么否定的立法的内容和本质就是：没有任何法律、没有任何统一、没有任何整体；所以那第一种非真理是无意识地、无成见地如此的那种非真理，而这第二种非真理则僭取形式，并因此把自己固定下来。

en: It is therefore not philosophy that takes the particular as something positive because it is a particular, but only insofar as it has won independence outside the absolute interconnection of the whole as a part of its own.

Absolute totality checks itself as necessity in each of its potencies, brings itself forth upon it as totality, repeats there both the preceding potencies and anticipates the following ones; but one of them is the greatest power, in whose colour and determinacy the totality appears, without however being anything restrictive for life, any more than water is for the fish or air for the bird.

It is at the same time necessary that individuality advance, metamorphose itself, and that what belongs to the ruling potency grow weak and die off, so that all the stages of necessity appear as such on it; but the misfortune of the period of transition, that this growing strong of the new culture has not absolutely purified itself of what is past, is that wherein the positive lies.

And nature, although within a determinate shape it proceeds with uniform, yet not mechanically uniform, but uniformly accelerated motion, nonetheless also enjoys a new shape that it has won; as it springs into it, so it dwells in it.

As the bomb gives a jolt to its culmination and then rests in it for a moment, or as heated metal does not soften like wax but at once springs into the flow and dwells on it — for appearance is the transition into the absolutely opposed, hence infinite, and this stepping-forth of the opposed out of infinity or its nothing is a leap, and the determinate being of the shape in its newborn force is at first for itself, before it becomes conscious of its relation to something foreign — so growing individuality too has both the joyfulness of that leap and a duration of the enjoyment of its new form, until it gradually opens itself to the negative and is also in its downfall at once and breaking.
zh: 所以，并不是哲学因为特殊者是一个特殊者就把它当作肯定的东西，而只是就它已经在整体的绝对联系之外作为一个自己的部分争得了独立性而言。
绝对总体性作为必然性在它的每一个级次中抑制自身，在它上面把自己作为总体性产生出来，在那里既重复在先的诸级次，又预先把握了在后的诸级次；但其中有一个是最大的力量，总体性就在它的色彩和规定性中显现，却并不因此对生命成为某种限制性的东西，正如水对鱼、空气对鸟也不是限制性的东西一样。
同时必然的是，个体性要向前进展、要变形，并且使属于占统治地位的级次的东西变弱和死掉，以便必然性的所有阶段都在它身上作为这样的阶段出现；而过渡时期的那个不幸，即新的教养的这种增强并没有绝对地把自己从过去的东西中净化出来，正是肯定的东西所在的地方。
而自然，虽然在一个特定的形态内部以均匀的、却不是机械地一致的、而是均匀加速的运动前进，却还是享受它已经争得的一种新形态；它怎样跳进这个形态，也就怎样在其中逗留。

正像炮弹在达到它的顶点时猛地一顿、然后在那顶点上停留片刻，或者像被加热的金属并不像蜡那样软化，而是一下子跳进流动状态并在它上面逗留——因为现象是向绝对对立面的过渡，所以是无限的，而这种对立面从无限性或者从它的无中冒出来是一个跳跃，并且形态在它新生的力量中的定在首先是为它自己的，然后它才意识到自己与一个异己者的关系——，正在成长的个体性也同样既有那种跳跃的欢快，又有对它新形式的享受的持续，直到它渐渐向否定的东西敞开，并且在它的没落中也一下子断裂。

en: If now the philosophy of ethical life teaches to comprehend this necessity and to recognize the interconnection of its content as well as the determinacy of the same as absolutely bound up with spirit and as its living body, and opposes itself to the formalism that regards whatever it can subsume under the concept of particularity as contingent and dead, then the philosophy of ethical life at the same time recognizes that this livingness of individuality in general, whatever its shape may be, is a formal livingness; for the restrictedness of what belongs to necessity, although absolutely taken up into indifference, is only a part of necessity, not absolute total necessity itself, hence always a non-agreement of absolute spirit and its shape.

But for this absolute shape it cannot flee to the shapelessness of cosmopolitanism, nor to the emptiness of the rights of humanity and the equal emptiness of a state of peoples and the world republic, since such abstractions and formalities contain the very opposite of ethical livingness and are in their essence Protestant and revolutionary against individuality; rather, for the high idea of absolute ethical life it must also recognize the most beautiful shape; and since the absolute idea is in itself absolute intuition, with its construction the purest and freest individuality is immediately also determined, in which spirit intuits itself completely objectively in its shape and wholly, without return to itself out of the intuition, but immediately cognizes the intuition itself as itself, and precisely thereby is absolute spirit and perfect ethical life, which at the same time, in the manner presented above, wards off its entanglement with the negative — for what we have hitherto called positive is, as has emerged from the matter itself, considered in itself the negative — sets it over against itself as objective and as fate, and, by consciously granting it a power and a realm through the sacrifice of a part of itself, keeps its own life purified of it.
zh: 如果伦理的哲学教导以概念把握这种必然性，并把它的内容的联系以及内容的规定性认识为绝对地与精神相结合、并且是精神的活的躯体，同时把自己与形式主义对立起来——形式主义把它能归摄到特殊性概念之下的东西都看作偶然的和死的——，那么伦理的哲学同时也认识到，个体性的这种生动性，不论它的形态是什么，都是一种形式的生动性；因为属于必然性的东西的那种受限制性，虽然被绝对地接纳进无差别之中，也只是必然性的一个部分，而不是绝对的总体必然性本身，所以始终是绝对精神与它的形态的一种不一致。

但对于这个绝对的形态，它不能逃到世界主义的无形态性那里去，也不能逃到人权的空洞以及诸民族的国家和世界共和国的同样空洞那里去，因为这样的抽象和形式的东西包含着伦理的生动性的正相反面，并且按其本质针对个体性是新教式的和革命式的，相反，它必须为绝对伦理的崇高观念也认识出最美的形态；而由于绝对观念自在地就是绝对直观，所以随着对它的建构，最纯粹和最自由的个体性也就直接被规定了，在这种个体性中，精神完全客观地在它的形态中直观自己，并且完全地、不是从直观中返回自身，而是直接地把直观本身认作自己本身，并且正因此就是绝对精神和完满的伦理，这种伦理同时按照上面所展示的方式抵挡它与否定的东西的纠缠——因为我们迄今为止称为肯定的东西，正如从事情本身中产生出来的那样，就其自身来看就是否定的东西——，把否定的东西作为客观的东西和命运置于自己对面，并且由于它有意识地通过牺牲自己的一部分而给否定的东西让出一种暴力和一个王国，从而使自己的生命得以保持为从它之中净化出来的。

en: [August 1801]
zh: [August 1801]

en: Contradiction is the rule of truth, not the contradiction of the false.
zh: 矛盾是真理的规则，而不是虚假之物的矛盾。

en: The syllogism is the principle of idealism.
zh: 三段论是观念论的原则。

en: The square is the law of nature, the triangle of mind.
zh: 正方形是自然的法则，三角形是心灵的法则。

en: In true arithmetic there is no place either for addition except of the unit to the dyad, or for subtraction except of the dyad from the triad, nor for the triad as sum, nor for the unit as difference.
zh: 在真正的算术中，加法除非是单位加到二之上，减法除非是从三之中减去二，都没有位置，而三作为和、单位作为差也都没有位置。

en: As the magnet is a natural lever, so the gravity of the planets toward the sun is a natural pendulum.
zh: 正如磁石是一种自然的杠杆，行星朝向太阳的重力也是一种自然的摆。

en: The idea is the synthesis of the infinite and the finite, and all philosophy is in ideas.
zh: 观念是无限者和有限者的综合，而一切哲学都在观念之中。

en: Critical philosophy lacks ideas and is an imperfect form of scepticism.
zh: 批判哲学缺乏观念，并且是怀疑论的一种不完善的形态。

en: The matter of the postulate of reason that critical philosophy presents destroys that very philosophy, and is the principle of Spinozism.
zh: 批判哲学所提出的理性公设的质料，毁掉这哲学本身，并且是斯宾诺莎主义的原则。

en: The state of nature is not unjust, and for that very reason one must leave it.
zh: 自然状态并不是不公正的，正因为这一点才必须从它之中走出来。

en: The principle of moral science is the reverence that must be had for fate.
zh: 道德科学的原则是必须对命运怀有的敬畏。

en: Virtue excludes innocence both of acting and of suffering.
zh: 德性既排除了行动上的无辜，也排除了承受上的无辜。

en: Morality, absolute in all its parts, is repugnant to virtue.
zh: 在一切方面都绝对的道德与德性相抵触。
